correctness.rationale: The full proof computes intersection polynomials and five eigenvalue families with their multiplicities. Differentiation of the scaled bipartition eigenvalue proves a unique root before 1/q, and elementary inequalities keep every other nonconstant eigenvalue negative on that interval. Direct Taylor bounds yield \(q^3\beta_q\to1/\log(4/3)\). A standalone finite-field checker reconstructs all graph distances and confirms the complete distance spectra for q=2,3,4; these checks are not used as an infinite proof. The rank/dimension claims follow from the one-dimensional centered kernel.

value.rationale: Natural infinite geometries of girth eight have an exact snowflake/Euclidean embedding threshold with a non-obvious cubic decay law. The unique bipartition obstruction and sharp endpoint embedding dimension are structural, whereas the other \(2(q+1)(q^2+1)-2\) harmonic directions stay strictly negative. The result is not a textbook direct substitution or arbitrary small census; it requires a uniform all-parameter spectral comparison. Unequal orders and generalized higher polygons remain distinct natural boundaries.
